reason: An all-out 20-power attack forces both their creatures to chump, which puts them at 1 with an empty board; at 1 life you die to any burn either way, so holding blockers back gains little and leaves their pingers and attackers alive.
Get Out uses mana that would otherwise go to waste. It returns Crab to hand to be recast for UU on their turn, tapping the 8/6 deathtouch-lifelink token and Thorin, which buys a full turn at 4 life.
Hearth Elemental can't block the flying Ingris or the menace Warlock, so it does nothing at home; attacking deals 4 free damage, and the only risk is a Charm trick with the Warlock.
Both cast Day of Judgment. A keeps mana open for No More Lies and Consult at the end step; B taps out for a second Tablet, and its land play (Cori Mountain Monastery) is not in hand.
Flashing in Tidebinder now gives only a vanilla 3/2 that can't block the Hellkite. Holding it can counter a Magmatic Hellkite land-destruction trigger or blank Smaug.

Harmonizer and Ascension before combat, then the graveyard Passage and Tunnel, chain landfall triggers: doubled power plus trample from Ascension on Explorer lets it trample through the 1/1s for lethal. B wastes every landfall by casting after combat.

Spider-Man as Cryomancer gives a 4/4 plus draw-2 filtering to find the missing fifth land. With 4 mana, Deceit can only be evoked for one mode, trading a card for a temporary bounce of Nursery or a single discard.
A 3-land, 7-card hand with cheap threats (two Sarkhans, Voice of Victory) and Burst Lightning is a clear keep against control on the draw.

The opponent is tapped out, so Bitter Triumph on Smaug can wait until after the draw; that allows a better choice of discard and target with nothing lost, and A does not rule out casting it this turn.
The opponent is at 3 with no blockers and no untapped mana, so the attack (Smaug alone plus its Treasure trigger) is lethal either way; Biotech only adds redundancy.
